thread:
noah: quick heads-up — PR #20789 touches EKS network policy + runtime eviction timing. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we can canary. thinking Wed 10am PT merge window if we get approvals by Tue EOD. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/20789

devin: skimmed the diff. main changes are: adjust kube-proxy rules, add cluster-role for network-agent, tweak eviction grace to 30s. not huge but touches hot path. @serena can you double-check runtime impacts?

serena: looking now. planning to run the local cluster test and a short load run. my immediate concern is eviction grace change — could cause KV reconnections during bursty tails. will report perf numbers by EOD tomorrow.

maya: I can take security review. will check network policy scoping and that the new cluster-role doesn’t grant extra privileges. timeline works for me if i finish by Tue.

noah: thanks. also tagging @eli for canary ownership — we need someone to watch latency regressions during 2hr canary.

eli: I can own the canary. i'll set up the canary job and alerting on p50/p95 token latency + error rate. prefer to run Wed 10–12 PT.

devin: infra note — the cluster-role change requires infra approval and an RBAC justification. @infra-bot can you run the RBAC lint?

infra-bot: RBAC-lint: scanned changed manifests. Result: WARNING — cluster-role network-agent binds to system:masters? No. Privilege escalation: NONE. Requirement: 2 infra approvers for cluster-role changes. See https://infra.redwood/policy/rbac

serena: quick datapoint from local perf run: with eviction=30s p95 increased ~4% on our KV-heavy benchmark at scale=1000. not ideal but within canary threshold if we monitor closely. code snippet i ran:
```
kubectl exec -it loadgen -- ./run_bench --concurrency 200 --duration 600
```

maya: security note: KMS usage looks fine. one comment: the network-policy allow-ingress stanza is wide for the metrics port; suggest limiting to prometheus pods. small change.

devin: thanks — I'll update that network-policy to restrict to prometheus selector. also adding RBAC justification in the PR description. after that, can we get infra approvals?

noah: plan: devin updates PR today, maya merges small policy tweak, serena posts final numbers, infra gives approvals. if all green, eli kicks off canary Wed 10am PT, monitoring for 2 hours. fallback: rollback to previous deploy if p95 latency > +10% or errors spike > 2x.

serena: LGTM on changes after the eviction note is documented in the PR (observability + rollback plan). :thumbsup:

maya: security: clear with one minor comment (prometheus selector). will approve once change is pushed.

devin: pushed fixes and added RBAC justification. PTAL: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/20789

infra-bot: Policy-check: cluster-role change flagged as REQUIRES_APPROVAL. Approvers_needed=2. Auto-tests passed.

eli: set up canary runbook and alerts. will DM oncall before starting.

noah: great — assigning infra approvers: @devin (owner) and @noah (secondary). can someone from infra team please leave a final thumbs up so we can schedule canary?

(infra member) raj: quick ack — i'll take one infra approval slot. looking at the diff now.

raj: ok from infra side after the RBAC justification update. :white_check_mark:

devin: thanks raj. that should be 2 approvals (maya + raj) once maya clicks approve.

maya: approved and left comment about restricting metrics.

noah: perfect — all approvals in. eli will run canary Wed 10am PT. i'll mark merge window and coordinate post-canary. thanks everyone for the quick async coordination.

eli: running canary. will post updates to this thread and ping if thresholds hit. :rocket:
